steps.content: Floods and downpour, from dragon's claws. Grand scales clanking, vast bones rumbling.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Alrighty! The hero obtained a fine bow body. The next task was to find the legendary bowstring! To the east!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But when the hero arrived at the shore of East Sea, there was a huge, huge flood happening there! And the culprit was a Wraith Dragon!
Yanyan puts away the divination wheel and grabs your hand excitedly.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Let's get moving, ${PlayerName}! The next target is right over there!
Yanyan points to the Rust on the map.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: So something is indeed wrong at the Rust...
You arrive at the periphery of the Rust and find that the once-stabilized contamination in the Rust is rising rapidly. It's even beginning to flow.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Chief, due to the influence of Mania, the contamination at the bottom of the Rust is forming a current and gushing out constantly. If we don't stop it promptly, the contamination will spread rapidly toward West District.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It seems much shallower than the floods in Eastia. But a toxic flood is no good sign nonetheless! Many monsters will come following this! Like the prawn soldiers, the crab generals, and the turtle minister. They're all underlings of that evil dragon!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: To calm the floods and eliminate the aquatic monsters, we must first defeat the dragon causing all this trouble!
As you're discussing strategies, you suddenly hear a cry for help.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: Help! Can anybody give us a hand! Someone's getting trapped by contamination! Help...
It's the scavengers at the Rust. They are also affected by the rising current of the Rust and seem to have run into trouble.
He clings desperately to an arm in the pool of contamination, looking like he's about to give out.
The FAC soldiers react instantly, and within two minutes, they are helping the two elderly people to the shore.
Next to them, Yanyan is patting the back of the saved scavenger rather skillfully, then hands him a water bottle.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Here's some water, sir. Drink slowly and be careful not to choke on it!

steps.speaker: Scavenger B
steps.content: Thank you... Thank you so much...
The feeble scavenger tries to express his gratitude with what little consciousness he has left. You only nod to signal him to conserve his strength and not to make any unnecessary movements.
